title: Colmenares calls for peaceful arrest of Bato ahead of Duterte ICC trial

blocks.text: MANILA – Human rights lawyer Neri Colmenares on Monday urged Philippine authorities to pursue the arrest of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa peacefully, saying the government must fulfill its obligations under the law as the International Criminal Court (ICC) prepares to try former president Rodrigo Duterte.
